name: find_user
description: Check an email and/or phone the customer mentions (matches either) against Acme accounts. Use it for a 'duplicate account' or 'my other account' question. Returns whether it matches the customer's own account, and for any OTHER account only its status, kyc_status and dates: never its id, name or contact details, and never confirm another account's details to the customer.

phone.description: Phone number in any format; matched on its last 10 digits

name: get_user
description: Get one user's profile: status (ACTIVE | BLOCKED | FROZEN | DORMANT | CLOSED), kyc_status, signup and last login time, referral code. Call after the user is identified and verified.

name: find_user_by_reference
description: Check whether a transaction reference the customer gave belongs to their account: a UTR (deposit or payout), a blockchain tx hash (crypto deposit or withdrawal) or an order id. Returns where it was found and belongs_to_you. If it belongs to another account, share nothing about it (SUP-01).

name: get_user_devices
description: List a user's devices (platform, app version, trusted or not, first and last seen). Use for login problems, app issues and to spot a new device in an unauthorized-access case.

name: get_auth_events
description: List a user's login and security events (logins, failed logins with reason, OTPs, password and 2FA resets, phone/email changes), newest first. Use for login trouble, blocked accounts, cooldowns after a security change, and unauthorized access.

days.description: How many days back to look (default 30)

from_time.description: Only events at or after this time, ISO 8601 (instead of days)

to_time.description: Only events at or before this time, ISO 8601

name: get_otp_logs
description: List OTPs sent to a phone/email or user (channel, provider, delivery status, provider error), newest first. Use when the customer is not receiving OTPs at signup or login.

destination.description: Phone (matched on last 10 digits) or email the OTP was sent to

hours.description: How many hours back to look (default 24)

name: get_otp_delivery_health
description: Check OTP delivery across ALL users for a recent window: how many OTPs failed and to how many numbers. Many failures for many numbers means a provider outage, not the customer's problem.

name: get_bank_accounts
description: List a user's bank accounts (masked number, IFSC, bank, holder name returned by the bank, status, verification method, name_match_score 0-100, primary or not).

days.description: Only accounts added in the last N days

name: find_bank_account_owners
description: Check whether OTHER Acme accounts have linked the same bank account (bank_account_sop BNK-10). Returns, for each other account, only the link status and that account's status: never who it is. Never tell the customer anything about the other account.

name: get_bank_verification_failures
description: Check bank verification across ALL users: failed verifications per bank in a recent window. Many failures at one bank = that bank's penny-drop is down, not the customer's problem.

name: get_deposits
description: List a user's INR deposits, newest first, with status, UTR, method and failure_reason. Filter by method, status, failure_reason, how many days back, or one calendar date. Then call check_deposit on the one the customer means.

days.description: Only deposits from the last N days

on_date.description: Only deposits created on this date, YYYY-MM-DD

statuses.description: Only these statuses, e.g. INITIATED, PENDING, ON_HOLD

name: check_deposit
description: Deposit checker: everything about one INR deposit in one call. Returns the deposit (status, UTR, amount, failure_reason, age in minutes), its payment-gateway record (gateway_status, bank_reference, webhook and last poll time), the ledger credit(s) it produced, and any refund (status, refund_utr). ledger_credited=false on a SUCCESS deposit means status and ledger disagree: escalate.

name: find_deposits_by_reference
description: Find the customer's deposits by a bank reference (UTR / RRN) they gave, with any gateway record for that reference. used_by_another_account=true means the UTR belongs to a different Acme account: share nothing about it and verify identity (SUP-01). No deposits and no gateway record = the payment never reached Acme.

name: get_refunds
description: List a user's refunds (of deposits or withdrawals), newest first, with status, refund_utr, timing and, for deposit refunds, the original deposit's amount, method and status. Refunds take 5-7 working days (DD-09).

name: get_supported_networks
description: Get the networks Acme supports for an asset: deposits_enabled, withdrawals_enabled, required_confirmations, min_withdrawal, withdrawal_fee and any maintenance_note. An asset/network missing here is not supported.

name: get_crypto_deposits
description: List the customer's crypto deposits, or find one of theirs by tx hash (a hash on another account is not returned: use find_user_by_reference to tell 'not found' from 'another account'). Returns asset, network, amount, to_address, memo_tag, confirmations vs required_confirmations, status, and whether the ledger was credited.

statuses.description: Only these statuses, e.g. DETECTED, CONFIRMING, MANUAL_REVIEW

tx_hash.description: Blockchain transaction hash the customer gave

name: get_deposit_addresses
description: List a user's own deposit addresses (asset, network, address, memo_tag). Use to check the customer sent to the right address, network and memo.

name: find_deposit_address_owner
description: Check a deposit address (and memo/tag for shared-address coins like XRP): is it an Acme address, and is it the customer's own? Use for missing-memo recovery or when a customer sent to another Acme address. Never says whose address it is.

memo_tag.description: Memo / destination tag, if the coin uses one

name: get_address_whitelist
description: List a user's whitelisted withdrawal addresses: status PENDING_COOLDOWN (new address, 24-hour cooldown until active_from) | ACTIVE | REMOVED.

days.description: Only addresses added in the last N days

name: get_kyc_applications
description: Get all of a user's KYC attempts, newest first, each with its documents (doc_type, verification_status, failure_reason, name_on_doc, dob_on_doc). Shows rejection_reason_code and attempt_number (max 3 attempts). SANCTIONS_HIT is Compliance-only: never disclose it.

name: get_kyc_vendor_logs
description: List the KYC vendor checks for one application (PAN verify, Aadhaar OTP, face match, liveness, sanctions), newest first. A response_code of 5xx or TIMEOUT means the vendor failed, not the customer.

check_types.description: Only these check types: PAN_VERIFY, AADHAAR_OTP, FACE_MATCH, LIVENESS, SANCTIONS

limit.description: Return at most this many rows (default 20)

name: get_kyc_vendor_health
description: Check KYC vendor health across ALL users: failed vendor calls (5xx or TIMEOUT) per check type in a recent window. Several failures = a vendor outage (kyc_sop KYC-14): the customer did nothing wrong.

name: get_rewards
description: List a user's rewards: type, campaign, asset, amount, status (PENDING | ELIGIBLE | CREDITED | EXPIRED | REVOKED | ON_HOLD), eligibility_reason, credit and expiry time.

name: get_campaigns
description: Look up reward campaigns and their rules: by id, by type and status, by part of the name the customer used, or the ones running at a given time (e.g. the user's signup time).

active_at.description: Only campaigns running at this time, ISO 8601

name_contains.description: Part of the offer name, any case, e.g. 'diwali'

name: get_referrals
description: A user's referrals in both directions: as_referee (the code they used at signup, its status and rejection_reason) and as_referrer (people they invited). rejection_reason is e.g. SAME_DEVICE, CODE_APPLIED_LATE, QUALIFYING_TRADE_NOT_MET.

name: get_coupon
description: Look up a coupon code (any case): campaign, redemptions used out of the maximum, status ACTIVE | EXPIRED | EXHAUSTED, valid_until, and whether it is a personal code valid for this customer.

name: get_risk_holds
description: List a user's risk holds (account freeze, withdrawal/deposit/reward hold, trade restriction). INTERNAL ONLY: never tell the customer the reason_code or source, and for source LAW_ENFORCEMENT do not even confirm that an agency is involved (fraud_risk_sop).

name: get_tickets
description: List a user's support tickets, newest first: channel, category, status, priority, assigned team and response times. Use to find an existing ticket before opening a new one, and for SLA questions.

days.description: Only tickets from the last N days

open_only.description: Only tickets not yet RESOLVED or CLOSED

name: get_notifications
description: List notifications sent to a user (push, SMS, email), newest first, with template and delivery status. Use when the customer says they did not get an alert.

name: get_tax_records
description: A user's tax records per financial year: TDS deducted, Form 16A status (NOT_AVAILABLE | GENERATED) and when the P&L statement was generated.

name: get_closure_requests
description: A user's account closure requests, newest first: status (REQUESTED | BLOCKED_BY_BALANCE | BLOCKED_BY_HOLD | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | WITHDRAWN), reason, created and completed time.

name: get_orders
description: List a user's orders, newest first: symbol, side, type, quantity, price, filled quantity, average fill price, status, reject_reason, source (APP | WEB | API | SIP). Filter by symbol, status, source, a time range (ISO 8601) or how many days back. Then call check_order.

days.description: Only orders from the last N days

statuses.description: Only these statuses, e.g. the open ones: NEW, OPEN, PARTIALLY_FILLED

symbol.description: Only this market, e.g. BTC-INR (a coin like BTC also works)

name: check_order
description: Order checker: everything about one order in one call. Returns the order, every fill (trade) with the fee and GST charged next to what they should be (0.2% fee + 18% GST, DD-09), totals across fills, trade ids charged a fee more than once (fee_charged_twice), and the SIP run that placed it, if any.

order_id.description: order_id from get_orders or the customer

name: get_trades
description: List a user's trades (fills), newest first: symbol, side, price, quantity, fee, gst, tds. Filter by symbol, side or a time range (ISO 8601).

symbol.description: Only this market, e.g. BTC-INR (a coin like BTC also works)

name: get_instrument
description: Get a market's trading rules and status: TRADING | HALTED | DELISTED | POST_ONLY, min and max order value, tick size, lot size. Use when an order was rejected or a coin cannot be bought.

name: get_market_price_range
description: Lowest and highest traded price of a market (ALL users) in a time window. Use to check a limit or stop price was ever reached, or whether a fill price was in line with the market at that moment.

name: get_price_incidents
description: Price or platform incidents (wrong price feed, outage) with any compensation_policy. Give at_time to get incidents active at that moment; give only a symbol to get its latest incident.

at_time.description: Only incidents active at this time, ISO 8601

name: get_order_error_count
description: Count orders rejected with SYSTEM_ERROR across ALL users around a moment. Several = a platform issue (trade_sop TRD-01), not the customer's mistake.

minutes.description: Look this many minutes before and after (default 15)

name: get_sip_plans
description: List a user's SIP plans (symbol, amount, frequency, status ACTIVE | PAUSED | CANCELLED, next run), each with its last 10 runs (status, failure_reason, order_id).

name: check_wallet_balance
description: Wallet checker: a user's balances per asset (available, locked = reserved by open orders or pending withdrawals) next to the sum of their ledger entries. matches_ledger=false means available + locked is not what the ledger says (DD-10): do not guess, escalate to Payments Ops (INR) or Crypto Ops, P1.

asset.description: Only this asset, e.g. INR or BTC

name: get_ledger_entries
description: List a user's ledger entries (every balance change: +credit / -debit), newest first. Filter by asset, entry types, a reference (reference_type + reference_id, e.g. TRADE 901), all fills of an order (order_id), a time range or how many days back. Use to explain a balance or an unexpected deduction.

days.description: Only entries from the last N days

entry_types.description: Only these entry types, e.g. REWARD, DEPOSIT

order_id.description: Only the TRADE entries of this order's fills (an order with no fills has none)

reference_id.description: Only entries for this record id (use with reference_type)

reference_type.description: Only entries for this kind of record

name: get_fee_summary
description: Totals a user paid between two times: trading fee, GST and TDS from all trades (no row limit), and INR withdrawal fees (fees_charges_sop FEE-11, tax_statements_sop TDS questions). Times are ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-04-01T00:00:00+00:00.

name: get_withdrawals
description: List a user's withdrawals (INR or crypto), newest first: amount, fee, status, payout_utr or tx_hash, hold_reason. Filter by asset, status, a bank account, or how many days back. Then call check_withdrawal.

asset.description: INR or a crypto symbol, e.g. USDT

bank_account_id.description: Only withdrawals to this bank account

days.description: Only withdrawals from the last N days

statuses.description: Only these statuses, e.g. the still-open ones

name: check_withdrawal
description: Withdrawal checker: everything about one withdrawal in one call. Returns the withdrawal (status, amount, fee, payout_utr / tx_hash, hold_reason, hours since request), the destination bank account (INR), its ledger entries (WITHDRAWAL, FEE, and REVERSAL if the payout failed and money returned) and any refund. hold_reason is internal: never quote it to the customer.
